description.en: Adds the "Sub2API" account type: the API key of another Sub2API site (the legacy release or sub2api-next, your own Base URL) that serves the built-in openai (chat completions, responses including its WebSocket mode, embeddings, image generations and edits), anthropic (messages, count_tokens) and gemini (generateContent, streamGenerateContent, countTokens) platforms. Requests are forwarded in their own protocol as they are, with each protocol's official auth header; nothing is converted. The key's balance is read from the site's GET /v1/usage. The plugin builds the upstream requests; the core sends them, so the plugin itself makes no network connection. Model prices are set by administrators in the core.
description.zh: 新增"Sub2API"账号类型：另一个 Sub2API 站点（旧版或 sub2api-next，自填 Base URL）的 API Key，服务内置 openai（Chat Completions、Responses（含 WebSocket 模式）、Embeddings、生图与图片编辑）、anthropic（Messages、count_tokens）、gemini（generateContent、streamGenerateContent、countTokens）平台。请求按原协议原样转发，各协议用官方的鉴权头，不做任何转换。从站点的 GET /v1/usage 读取 Key 的余额。插件构造上游请求，由核心发送，插件自身不发起任何网络连接。模型价格由管理员在核心中配置。

description.en: An API key of a Sub2API site. Each protocol goes to <Base URL> with its official path and auth header (OpenAI Authorization: Bearer, Anthropic x-api-key, Gemini x-goog-api-key). Which protocols a key serves depends on its group on the site.
description.zh: Sub2API 站点的 API Key。各协议按官方路径和鉴权头发往 <Base URL>（OpenAI 用 Authorization: Bearer，Anthropic 用 x-api-key，Gemini 用 x-goog-api-key）。Key 能用哪些协议取决于它在站点上所属的分组。

reason.en: Register the "Sub2API" account type for the built-in openai, anthropic and gemini platforms
reason.zh: 为内置 openai、anthropic、gemini 平台注册"Sub2API"账号类型
